channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: New Balance's Super Slim Hiking Shoe Isn't Scared to Get a Lil Weird with It
item.description: New Balance's MT10T sneaker might look like a water shoe but its really a super slim hiking shoe.

item.title: A Nike Classic's Perfectly Polychrome Colorway Deserves an Olympic Gold Medal
item.description: Originally released in 2004 and revived for 2026, we’re reminded how perfect the fit is. Shop the colorful Nike Air Max 95 Olympic.

item.title: No One Saw Thom Browne's ASICS Sneakers Coming (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Thom Browne's ASICS shoe collaboration, his first sportswear crossover, is a landmark luxury-sneaker moment for both the designer & fashion at large.

item.title: In Chocolatey Leather, These Bubble-Soled Nikes Prove They Scrub Up Nicely
item.description: The Nike Air Max DN8 Baroque Brown/Coconut Milk dropped together with an Air Max 95 Big Bubble in the same chocolate color. Double helpings of dessert, anyone?

item.title: Nike’s *Other* Dad Shoe Is a Tasteful Tonal Treat
item.description: Nike's V5 RNR "Dark Hazel" sneaker offers a rich olive green dad shoe style at the affordable price of $95.

item.title: This Is Basically the Iconic Jordan 1 Sneaker With a Better (Skyline) View
item.description: Nike's Air Jordan Skyline Low sneaker debuts as a new, affordable, & casual take on the AJ1 Low model. Basically, it's the classic with a view.

item.title: adidas’ Finest Samba-Flavored Sneaker Is Handmade in Germany
item.description: The adidas Handball Spezial sneaker gets the "Made in Germany" treatment, resulting in a luxurious black leather version.

item.title: Vans’ Exquisite Leather Skate Slipper Is as Tough as It Is Cozy
item.description: Vans' Mountain Mule is the brand's luxurious leather slipper model which looks almost too good for skating.

item.title: The Quiet Return of Nike’s Most Elegant Air Max Loafer
item.description: Nike's Air Max Phenomena sneaker-loafer makes a quiet return to the streets in its classic colorways.

item.title: Nike's Priciest Air Force 1 Shoe Is Basically a Birkin
item.description: Nike's super luxe Made in Italy Air Force 1 sneaker is essentially the footwear equivalent of a Birkin bag.
